newsitem.title: NORWAY: Kvaerner, Norsk Hydro cap gains on Oslo bourse.
newsitem.headline: Kvaerner, Norsk Hydro cap gains on Oslo bourse.

text.p: Norwegian shares recaptured most of day-earlier losses on Thursday as positive sentiment, low interest rates and a strong oil price continued to buoy the market.
But dealers said the gains were capped by a downturn in heavyweight blue chips Norsk Hydro and Kvaerner.
The Total share index advanced almost 0.3 cpercent to 833.96 points in healthy turnover of 790 million crowns. The index set a new all-time high on Tuesday at 885.01 points.
Norsk Hydro continued to flounder ahead of the release of third quarter results next Monday.
The stock relinquished 1.50 crowns to end at 308.50. Brokers said the depressed aluminium market continued to weigh on the share despite strong oil prices.
"Light metals do not seem to be turning round. Investors are opting to sell before the reults even though Hydro must be living well from the oil market at the moment," said one broker.
Kvaerner also continued to tread a downward path, ending 3.50 crowns off in the As at 245.50 crowns.
Brokers said the honeymoon period for the company since its merger with Britain's Trafalger House was over and the market was waiting to see some of the synergy effects.
